patient.name: 里见菜穗子
patient.diagnosis: 成年医疗AU：既往肺结核已完成治疗，但遗留局限性受损肺叶、肺叶支气管瘢痕性狭窄以及肺门血管周围复杂纤维化，局部肺动脉分支受累。拟行开胸袖式肺叶切除、支气管重建与肺动脉重建，以保留其余可用肺组织。
patient.diagnosis_en: Adult medical AU: After treatment of pulmonary tuberculosis, a localized damaged lobe, cicatricial lobar bronchial stenosis and complex hilar fibrosis remain, with involvement of a pulmonary artery branch. Open sleeve lobectomy with bronchial and pulmonary artery reconstruction is planned to preserve the remaining functional lung.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「医生，我以前从没认真想过，呼吸也是一件会变得困难的事。」
lines.text_en: “Doctor, I never used to think about breathing as something that could become difficult.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你的结核已经经过治疗。现在麻烦的是留下的支气管狭窄，以及肺门附近的瘢痕。」
lines.text_en: “Your tuberculosis has been treated. The problem now is the remaining bronchial narrowing and the scarring near the pulmonary hilum.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「所以，病好了，路却还没有通。」
lines.text_en: “So the illness has been treated, but the passage still has not opened.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「可以这么说。我们计划切除受损的肺叶，再重建支气管。肺动脉的一段也需要处理。」
lines.text_en: “You could put it that way. We plan to remove the damaged lobe and reconstruct the bronchus. Part of the pulmonary artery will also need repair.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……听上去，像要重新修一条让风吹过的路。」
lines.text_en: “...It sounds like rebuilding a passage for the wind.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是台复杂的开胸手术。我会准备熟悉气道和血管重建的团队。」
lines.text_en: “It is a complex open-chest operation. I will assemble a team prepared for airway and vascular reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「您说话很平静呢。其实我有一点害怕。」
lines.text_en: “You sound so calm. To be honest, I am a little afraid.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「害怕很正常。我们会仔细核对每一步，也会持续观察你的身体情况。」
lines.text_en: “It is natural to be afraid. We will check every stage carefully and monitor your condition throughout.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……那我也要准备一件事。」
lines.text_en: “...Then I have something to prepare as well.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「什么事？」
lines.text_en: “What is it?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「一张还没画完的画。等我能舒服地呼吸，我想把窗外的云补上。」
lines.text_en: “A painting I have not finished yet. When I can breathe more easily, I want to finish the clouds outside the window.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「坂口医生，窗帘可以拉开一点吗？」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Sakaguchi, could we open the curtains a little?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「可以。今天精神怎么样？」
lines.text_en: “Of course. How are you feeling today?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「胸口还会痛，呼吸也需要慢慢来。可是……已经不一样了。」
lines.text_en: “My chest still hurts, and I need to take breathing slowly. But... something is different.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「手术已经完成，支气管和血管的重建都做了。接下来要循序恢复，不能着急。」
lines.text_en: “The operation is complete, including the bronchial and vascular reconstruction. Recovery will take time, so do not rush.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我知道。您一定会说这句话。」
lines.text_en: “I know. I was sure you would say that.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那幅还没画完的画呢？」
lines.text_en: “What about that unfinished painting?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「就在床边。我想先画一小片云，别的等以后。」
lines.text_en: “It is beside my bed. I think I will start with a small patch of cloud and leave the rest for later.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「很好。以后还有时间慢慢画。」
lines.text_en: “Good. You will have time to paint the rest.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……谢谢你，医生。」
lines.text_en: “...Thank you, Doctor.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「等恢复得更好，把那幅画带来给我们看看吧。」
lines.text_en: “When you have recovered further, bring that painting and show it to us.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那您可要有耐心。我会画得很慢。」
lines.text_en: “Then you will have to be patient. I am going to paint it very slowly.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「不过，我知道风应该画在哪里了。」
lines.text_en: “But now I know where I want to paint the wind.”
